span.p:
Approved and Held block the venue for the occupied period
[start - setup, end + turnaround), copied onto the booking.
Needs Reconsideration is a flag on Pending, Held or Approved,
it never changes the status (SCRUM-26 AC2). A flagged booking
keeps blocking until resolved, and a flagged Pending or Held
booking can't be approved, held or confirmed (AC4, AC5).

svg.text: Venue booking status (BookingStatus) with the Needs Reconsideration flag
